notes:
Clause 44: correct treatment of Depreciation and Bad Debts (per ICAI's own FAQ).

Depreciation (Section 32) and bad/doubtful debts (Section 36(1)(vii)) must count toward "Total expenditure during the year" (Column 2) but must NOT be broken down into the registered/composition/exempt/unregistered columns (3-7). Previously a Depreciation ledger was mis-filed into the "exempt" bucket.

Now: Depreciation/bad-debts ledgers are pulled out of the four GST-registration buckets entirely (shown separately as "Excluded from breakup"), a new "Total Expenditure" figure is reported alongside the bucket breakup, and a manual override still lets the preparer deliberately file such a ledger into a bucket if needed.
